title: Stop wasting your time on LinkedIn 🔎
description:
If recruiters aren't responding to your DMs, maybe it's time to stop reaching out. Recruiters get hit with hundreds of messages every single day. There just isn't time to respond to everyone. If you are looking for possible assistance start engaging with people with similar job titles, find leaders in your industries and start networking with them. Otherwise your best use of time is to just find the jobs yourself, apply directly and move on to the next one. #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #careeradvice #linkedin #linkedintips #networkingtips
